name: klp
description: Lightweight CLI viewer for structured log files and streams (logfmt, JSONL and many others)

klp.description: Structured log parser with JSON/logfmt/CSV support and advanced time analysis
klp.usage:
klp file.jsonl # View JSON Lines log file
klp --filter 'severity == "ERROR"' app.log # Filter by condition
klp --time-range '2023-01-01,2023-12-31' logs.json # Filter by date range
klp --format json logs.csv # Convert CSV to JSON output
klp --grep pattern --context 2 server.log # Search with context lines
